cases.question: On which weekdays can staff work from home?

evidence.content: Remote Work Policy. Employees may work remotely on Tuesday and Thursday. Monday, Wednesday, and Friday are office days unless a manager approves an exception.
Paid Time Off Policy. Every full-time employee receives 15 days of paid time off per calendar year. Planned leave should be requested at least two weeks in advance.

cases.question: How long after buying something do I have to file an expense receipt?

evidence.content: Expense Policy. Employees must submit expense receipts within 10 calendar days of purchase. Manager approval is required for any single expense above 500 dollars.

cases.question: What should an employee do after suspecting a security incident?
cases.answer: Employees must not investigate the incident themselves. They should preserve relevant evidence and report the suspected incident within one hour through the security portal to the IT security team. [Source 3, Page 3] [Source 4, Page 4]

evidence.content: Security Incident Handling. Employees must not investigate a suspected incident themselves. Preserve relevant evidence and wait for instructions from the security team.
Security Incident Reporting. A suspected security incident must be reported within one hour through the security portal. Employees should notify the IT security team promptly.

cases.question: How much annual paid leave does a full-time employee get?
cases.answer:
Every full-time employee receives 15 days of paid time off per calendar year.
